components.css: .ds-chip { height:36px; padding:0 14px; border:1px solid rgba(55,53,47,.16); border-radius:999px; background:none; color:#5f5e5b; font:14px ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-chip:hover { background:rgba(55,53,47,.045); } .ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"] { background:rgba(31,111,197,.11); border-color:transparent; color:#1f6fc5; }

narrative.overview: A warm sheet of paper that is always open at the right page. The surface stays almost silent: warm off-white ground, graphite ink, hairline separators, and generous air between items. The composer is the anchor of the page; everything else waits underneath it. Colour does work, never decoration: each tab owns one of Notion's soft label colours and carries it everywhere it appears.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper ground, never pure white behind content.
Big targets: 48px tabs, 30px state buttons, 16px row padding.
Structure from hairlines and space, not boxes.
Navigation sits under the thumb in a fixed bottom bar.
Actions appear on hover on desktop and are always visible on touch.

rules.name: The Label Carries Its Colour Rule
rules.body: A tab's colour follows it everywhere: dot in the bar, active tab background, view tile, task chip, drop highlight. No other element borrows a tab colour.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Blue is only for the primary action, selection and focus. State uses amber and green, never blue.

rules.name: The Lift On Intent Rule
rules.body: Shadows grow only when something takes focus or floats above the page. Rows never get shadows; hover is a tonal wash.

dos: Do keep tasks airy: 16px row padding and at least 4px between rows.
Do give every action a visible button; keyboard shortcuts come in addition, never instead.
Do use a tab's own colour pair for anything that represents that tab.
Do theme both modes through the CSS variables in :root and :root[data-theme="dark"].
donts: Don't use typed syntax as the way to format text (no hashtags, no Markdown typing required); formatting comes from buttons, shortcuts or the selection bar.
Don't use pure white (#fff) as the page ground or pure black in dark mode.
Don't add cards, borders or density around rows; the owner asked for space.
Don't use Faint Grey (#b4b2ad) for text or for always-visible controls.
